skill.summary: Get generated video clips ready to post, without touching a single slider. Upload your text prompts or clips (MP4, MOV, PNG, JPG, up to 500MB), say something...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Generation Maker Generator, enabling users to generate 1080p videos from text prompts or uploaded images/clips.
- Supports uploads of MP4, MOV, PNG, JPG (and other popular formats) up to 500MB, with cloud GPU-powered rendering.
- Automatic setup with free trial tokens; session handles prompt-to-video workflow, including editing and export.
- Responsive to common commands such as upload, export, credits, and state/status checks.
- Fast cloud export pipeline: receive a downloadable MP4 in about 1–2 minutes.
- Designed for content creators and marketers to create videos quickly without manual editing.
